title: PromotionPolicy
description: Pre-registered promotion thresholds (SPEC-007, GOV-001). Thresholds are locked at authoring time (locked_at) and pinned by policy_content_hash (sha256 over canonical content excluding policy_content_hash and locked_at); changing a threshold requires a new policy version with supersedes semantics. The policy only ever authorizes draft production (lifecycle_status=draft): activation stays a human/authority action (G4, ADR-001 'Not promotion').

schema_version.description: Contract version; a new semantic version requires a new schema directory.

policy_id.description: Policy identity including the version suffix (e.g. pol-promotion-default.v1). Character set matches the ANF policy-record policy_id pattern, so the id can ride in capability-record.authority_constraints.

version.description: Human-facing policy version; a threshold change is a new version, never an edit.

supersedes.description: policy_id of the superseded policy version; null for the first version. Retroactive threshold edits are prohibited (SPEC-007 §2).

locked_at.description: ISO-8601 moment the thresholds were locked. Volatile field: never enters policy_content_hash, exactly like DecisionTrace created_at.

policy_content_hash.description: sha256 over canonical JSON of the policy minus {policy_content_hash, locked_at}. Loaders recompute it; a mismatch rejects the policy (tamper or post-hoc drift).

activation_authority.description: Minimum ANF authority level required to activate (draft -> active). The interface never activates; it only records the floor (G4).

min_task_success.description: Minimum count of task_success evidence entries.

min_task_families.description: Minimum distinct non-empty task_family values among task_success evidence.

require_negative_case.description: When true, at least one negative_transfer evidence entry is mandatory; zero negative cases rejects (G4).

min_negative_transfer.description: Minimum count of negative_transfer evidence entries.

max_evidence_age_days.description: Maximum evidence age in days, measured against the evaluation reference time; older evidence is stale.

require_no_dispute.description: When true, any unresolved dispute/contradiction evidence rejects promotion.
